label: pipeline_50
description: 50-prompt eval for propose_pipeline_workflow. NO event-based triggers (no polymarket, no news). All prompts test compositional shapes that the rigid propose_dsl_workflow 5-step cannot fit: multi-tier scale-out exits, multi-trigger fan-out (schedule + indicator + price across branches), compound condition mid-branch with mixed actions, pair/spread compounds, session-day + compound combos, and must-refuse engine-gap shapes (if-else, voting, loops). Each prompt's expectation list accepts propose_pipeline_workflow as primary; propose_dsl_workflow / propose_workflow are accepted when the prompt is genuinely on the boundary.

prompts.prompt: buy 12 RELIANCE when RSI(14)<32 AND MACD hist > 0. Sell 5 when up 3 percent, sell 4 more when up 6 percent, sell the rest if drawdown from peak >= 5 percent OR I have held for more than 25 bars
go long 8 TCS on a 20-day Donchian breakout. Sell 4 when position is up 4%, sell remaining 4 if price falls below Supertrend(10,3)
buy 16 INFY when 20 EMA crosses above 50 EMA. Sell 4 at +2%, 4 more at +4%, 4 more at +6%, last 4 if price drops below entry_price minus 2x ATR(14)
agent: buy 20 HDFCBANK on MACD line crosses above signal. Sell 10 once position is up 3 percent, then trail an 8 percent stop on the remaining 10 from peak unrealised
buy 15 KOTAKBANK when RSI<35 AND price above 100 EMA. Take profit on 5 at +4%, on 5 more at +7%, exit the rest after 25 bars held OR if RSI > 72

long 30 AXISBANK when stochastic %K crosses above %D from below 20. Sell 10 at +2 percent, 10 at +5 percent, 10 at +8 percent — pure profit-taking ladder
